files.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=69", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "m3diff"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Official implementation of M3Diff for fine-grained image difference captioning"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { file = "LICENSE" }
authors = [
  { name = "Yuan Liu" },
]
keywords = [
  "image difference captioning",
  "multimodal large language model",
  "computer vision",
  "LLaVA",
]
classifiers = [
  "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
  "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
  "License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
  "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]
dependencies = [
  "einops==0.6.1",
  "einops-exts==0.0.4",
  "huggingface-hub>=0.34,<1.0",
  "packaging>=23.0",
  "pillow>=10.0",
  "shortuuid>=1.0.13",
  "tokenizers==0.19.1",
  "torch==2.2.2",
  "torchvision==0.17.2",
  "tqdm>=4.66",
  "transformers==4.40.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
train = [
  "accelerate==0.29.1",
  "bitsandbytes==0.41.0",
  "datasets==2.16.1",
  "decord==0.6.0",
  "deepspeed==0.14.4",
  "hf-transfer>=0.1.9",
  "numpy==1.26.1",
  "opencv-python>=4.8",
  "peft==0.4.0",
  "scikit-learn==1.2.2",
  "scipy>=1.10",
  "sentencepiece==0.1.99",
  "timm>=1.0",
  "tyro>=0.8",
  "wandb>=0.16",
]
eval = [
  "pycocoevalcap>=1.2",
  "pycocotools>=2.0.7",
]
dev = [
  "build>=1.2",
  "ruff>=0.6",
]

[project.urls]
Paper = "https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2025/html/Liu_OmniDiff_A_Comprehensive_Benchmark_for_Fine-grained_Image_Difference_Captioning_ICCV_2025_paper.html"
Repository = "https://github.com/Yuan-Liu-01/M3Diff"
Checkpoint = "https://huggingface.co/IVC-liuyuan/M3Diff"
"Training annotations" = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/IVC-liuyuan/training_m3diff"

[tool.setuptools]
include-package-data = false

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["llava*"]

[tool.black]
line-length = 100
target-version = ["py310"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I"]
ignore = ["E501"]
